description: This file defines the ApiCallMonitoringMiddleware class, which extends AbstractMonitoringMiddleware, providing middleware functionality for AWS SDK to monitor API call attempts, responses, and exceptions. It includes methods for wrapping handlers, extracting request and response data, handling attempt counts, and tracking specific event keys related to AWS API call monitoring.

classes.name: ApiCallMonitoringMiddleware
classes.description: Middleware class for monitoring AWS SDK API calls, handling attempt counts, retries, and event data collection.

methods.name: wrap
methods.description: Creates a middleware handler with provided credentials, options, region, and service, that wraps the next handler in the stack.

methods.name: getRequestData
methods.description: Extracts data from the request object. Currently returns an empty array.

methods.name: getResponseData
methods.description: Extracts attempt count and max retries info from the response or exception object.
